task: FAL-281 (slice B of the FAL-271 art audit)
method: Animate the shipped idle still, never draw fresh: sprite-animator renders a 124-frame H3 clip whose first and last frame are the still, and 12 evenly spaced frames are taken from it (played ping-pong, 1..12..2, at 8 fps). finish_idle.py crops all 12 with one union box, scales them together to a 236 px figure, then despill.py regrows the magenta-fringed edge RGB from the interior and repaints the 1 px outline after the resize. pack_source.py --grid lays out each species pair; sheets.json "register": "grid" keeps the registration in the build (the walk packer re-centred every frame on its upper body and slid owlet-boy 5 px with planted feet).
format: 12 frames in one row of equal cells, frameWidth from data/assets.js, 239-240 px tall; play ping-pong (0,1,..,11,10,..,1) at 8 fps = a 22-step, 2.75 s cycle.
